rules: Every team must be reconciled after the final 53-man deadline, not inferred from a pre-deadline projection.
Active/PUP and Active/NFI players require an explicit final resolution at cutdown.
Reserve/PUP and Reserve/NFI imply the league-required opening absence and must propagate to player availability and team context.
Fantasy-relevant and materially impactful OL/defensive players must be resolved individually when their status affects model inputs.
Roster moves after the initial 53, including waiver claims and post-cutdown IR moves, remain part of the Week 1 reconciliation.
No final team prior may claim current-roster completeness while any team remains PENDING_FINAL_53.
